pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-to-large polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients. Patches on the flank show distinct vertical elongation, while those on the lower neck and shoulder are more irregular and smaller in spatial area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored negative space. Features narrow pixel thickness with frequent tri-radiate and tetra-radiate junction nodes creating a high-connectivity topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, high-contrast mane showing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background along the cervical dorsal line.
